comparator.name: Computational Social Science
comparator.sourceNotes: The official current study-programme page publishes five required 30-EC semester modules plus 30 EC of genuine fifth-semester choice, for 180 ECTS in total. The first four modules integrate social-science, digital, research and change-making expertise around climate/surveillance, behavioural interventions, health/mobility and responsible AI/inequality. The final semester is a 30-EC capstone with an external organisation.
components: Foundation: Appreciating the complexity of social challenges
Building blocks: Experimenting with digital interventions of behavioural change
Connections: Linking data for better interventions in health or mobility systems
Structures: Applying responsible AI to reduce inequality
Minor, electives, internship or study abroad
Genuine fifth-semester choice space; no specific option is invented.
Capstone: Making social change with digital innovations

core: Computational social science combining human behaviour, social research and data-driven public problem solving
Programming, data analysis, visualisation and machine learning for social impact
Project-based digital intervention, stakeholder collaboration and responsible innovation
adjacent: Climate, mobility and data-driven environmental intervention
Responsible AI, inequality, surveillance and algorithmic power
questions: How can computational methods turn social evidence into responsible digital solutions?
How can data and digital interventions improve climate, mobility or health systems?
How do surveillance, algorithms and AI reproduce or reduce social inequality?

alternatives.label: Computational Social Science & Public Innovation
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum visibly combines computational and social-science methods with public problem-solving and innovation, without claiming UvA’s integrated semester-project pedagogy.
alternatives.concept: A closest feasible interdisciplinary pathway combining programming, data science, social research, politics, communication, behavioural science and applied innovation for public challenges.
progression: Programming, data, social research, communication and disciplinary foundations precede machine learning, advanced politics, cognition and project-oriented innovation. Formal prerequisites and planned offerings pass, with eight 300-level courses.

alternatives.label: Climate, Mobility & Geospatial Data
alternatives.labelReason: The curriculum combines climate, water, sustainability and environmental governance with programming, quantitative methods and machine learning; geospatial data is represented through the delta and environmental sequence.
alternatives.concept: Builds the evidenced climate and mobility direction around earth systems, sustainability, water and delta governance, programming, statistics, machine learning and spatially informed intervention design.
progression: Earth-system, sustainability, programming, mathematics and data foundations precede environmental methods, machine learning, climate governance and advanced delta research. Formal prerequisites and planned offerings pass, with eight 300-level courses.
alternatives.distinctness: This route makes climate, mobility-related spatial systems and environmental data the application domain; it differs from both other programmes by well over four courses and 30 EC.

alternatives.label: Responsible AI, Inequality & Digital Society
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum visibly combines sociology of digital society and inequality with machine learning, media, politics, behavioural evidence and responsible innovation.
alternatives.concept: Builds the evidenced responsible-AI and inequality direction around sociology, politics, media, psychology, machine learning, deep learning, ethics, entrepreneurship and qualitative and quantitative social research.
progression: Sociology, politics, communication, mathematics and qualitative-methods foundations precede machine learning, deep learning, media analysis and advanced sociology. Formal prerequisites and planned offerings pass, with eight 300-level courses.
alternatives.distinctness: This route centres algorithmic power, inequality, surveillance and responsible AI; it differs from the broad closest match and the environmental-data route by more than four courses and 30 EC.
traceOverrides: develops data visualisation, cleaning and manipulation skills, directly implementing Big Data en Computational Thinking's computational-thinking content and the big-data-and-computational-social-research interest
develops persuasive public-speaking and real-world communication about contested issues, a concrete complementary contribution to Media, macht en technologie's media-and-public-debate content

blocks: Both establish beginner programming and computational problem-solving foundations.
Both apply machine learning while requiring critical reflection on model decisions and effects.
Both use qualitative social research to understand stakeholders and complex systems.
Both turn communication and design ideas into an applied prototype or intervention.
Both culminate in advanced, applied research addressing a complex public challenge.
No single selected UCR course is presented as a direct counterpart to Minor, electives, internship or study abroad.

selection.assessment: The closest match owns the programme-defining integration of computation, social research, public problem solving and responsible intervention. Climate/mobility data and responsible AI/inequality are the two strongest coherent remaining directions and yield feasible, substantively distinct curricula. Health systems and technology is also coherent but cannot be added after the three-alternative maximum is reached.

notes.text: UvA integrates social, digital, research and change-making expertise inside 30-EC semester projects with external partners. UCR distributes related study across 24 separately credited Liberal Arts and Sciences courses.
The fifth semester is published as 30 EC of minor, electives, internship or study abroad. That genuine choice space is preserved as an aggregate rather than populated with an invented option.
